message: 魔王今昔

name: Macaron
message: 「Phew~ That's about it for today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Good work~」

name: Macaron
message: 「Good work. I'm thirsty~」

name: Synn
message: 「Which do you want, cold tea or lukewarm milk?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Are you...... messing with me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy! The canteen!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't treat me like your errand boy.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm counting on you as a top-notch second.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nice way of putting it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Here, Macaron, have some tea.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Thanks.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Gulp, gulp, gulp...... Haaah~, delicious!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Man, how do you guys keep training every single day without getting sick of it?」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I slack off, my body gets out of shape right away.」

name: Synn
message: 「It seems good for our health, too.」

name: Macaron
message: 「"To become stronger, fight opponents stronger than yourself"」

name: Macaron
message: 「"Daily training is what you do so you don't get weak before that happens"」

name: Macaron
message: 「Right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「What's that?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Paqy-sama said it a long time ago. Don't you remember?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aaaah...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Now that you mention it, I sort of feel like I might've said something like that, maybe...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come on, back when you came to the Kingdom of Ratafia with Master and the others!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hrmmm...」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe smacking him will knock it loose.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Brain!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ooh! I remember now!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're that little squirt from back then!」

name: Synn
message: 「You two already knew each other?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, sort of. Back when I was traveling through the Demon World with the previous Demon Lord to gather allies.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Brings back memories, doesn't it? I've grown up a whole lot too, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Dunno about that. Looks like your chest hasn't changed a bit.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Mghhh! Says you, Paqy-sama--you're the one who shrank!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Shut up, it's by design!」

name: Synn
message: 「The previous Demon Lord... Master...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hm? What's wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be that Macaron's master is...」

name: Synn
message: 「My dad?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Paqy
message: 「That'd be right.」

name: Synn
message: 「What!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Is that true!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I met the little squirt back when I was traveling with the previous Demon Lord. No doubt about it.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh, but Master having a kid...」

name: Synn
message: 「When Dad was young, with Macaron... hmm?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, time flows differently between the Demon World and the Human World, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「How convenient!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Geez, why didn't you tell me sooner!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Draft!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Keeping something this important a secret!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I-I just assumed you'd already noticed...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not as experienced as you are, you know.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Muu~... this feels kinda weird.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Even if you tell me all of a sudden, it doesn't feel real...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey, um, where is Master right now...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. He's overseas with Mom for work.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I see...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, really... it's kind of a strange feeling.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Before I knew it, I'd ended up right next to Master...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Even though I thought he was so far away...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Hey, what was Dad like back in the day?」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Do you wanna know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. If you don't mind, I'd love for you to tell me.」

name: Synn
message: 「About Dad, and about you too, Macaron.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I see, I see...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Let's see...」

name: Macaron
message: 「This happened back when I still lived in the castle of the Ratafia Kingdom...」

name: Macaron
message: 「While I was taking a walk in the garden, I happened to find Master collapsed on the ground.」

name: Macaron
message: 「It was quite a shocking first meeting, let me tell you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, if someone was collapsed on the ground...」

name: Macaron
message: 「That was the very first time I ever met someone from outside the castle...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Believe it or not, I used to be a sheltered little princess.」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron...」

name: Macaron
message: 「And you know, it turned out Master had gotten separated from his companions.」

name: Macaron
message: 「On top of losing his way, he was starving, so he was basically stranded even though he was right in the castle garden.」

name: Macaron
message: 「All I did at the time was share some snacks I had on me, though...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Master made such a big deal out of it, saying things like, 'I'll definitely repay this debt'」

name: Macaron
message: 「I guess it started after that...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Master started sneaking in to see me...」

name: Macaron
message: 「And I started meeting up with Master in secret from Papa and Mama too.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Master told me all sorts of stories about his adventures, and before long, I started looking forward to them...」

name: Macaron
message: 「At first, Master would even sneak me out of the castle, but...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Eventually, I started sneaking out all on my own.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why would Dad do something like that...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「The previous Demon Lord just couldn't stand seeing the little squirt looking so bored all the time.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Honestly, life in the castle just wasn't any fun...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hehehe... How embarrassing.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, since you're a princess... were your parents super strict?」

name: Macaron
message: 「To be honest, they actually didn't pay much attention to me at all...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Not that I even remember anymore!」

name: Macaron
message: 「By the way, the Great Sage was a pink bear mascot suit! The exact model for this coat!」

name: Macaron
message: 「He basically doubled as Master's sleeping bag.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I switched over to this body after that Re-Crea wrapped up, though.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Anyway, one day I got kidnapped by a bad Demon outside the castle.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Things were pretty rough in the Demon World back then because of Re-Crea.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, so that's when Dad swooped in to save you.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, yeah, that happened, but...」

name: Macaron
message: 「You won't believe what Mom and Dad did back then...」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh-huh.」

name: Macaron
message: 「They tried to haggle down my ransom!? Unbelievable, right!」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, well, maybe that's just a different kind of love... No, probably not...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Master was totally different, though.」

name: Macaron
message: 「He showed up in a flash and saved me in the coolest way possible!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Angels, Demons, and all his other friends pitched in to help too...」

name: Macaron
message: 「That was all thanks to how much everyone loved and respected Master!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, I figure you already know most of what happened after that, Your Majesty.」

name: Synn
message: 「She looked up to Dad so much that she started training to become a Demon Lord.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah, that's pretty much the gist of it.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Back then, though, I wasn't really thinking that deeply about it.」

name: Macaron
message: 「When we said goodbye, Master told me he was going off to accomplish something huge...」

name: Macaron
message: 「He meant he was going to stop Re-Crea, didn't he.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Paqy
message: 「The former Demon Lord didn't tell ya the details so he wouldn't make ya worry, shorty.」

name: Synn
message: 「Dad really tried to act all cool when it's not even his style...」

name: Macaron
message: 「When he handed Alzard down to me, he was acting super cool!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Now that I have gained true power as the Demon Lord, I no longer have need for this blade.」

name: Macaron
message: 「However, it shall now guide Macaron, who inherits it, to become the next Demon Lord.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Until the day Macaron becomes a splendid Demon Lord, farewell! Fwa-hahahaha!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Just like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I can kinda picture that...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Looking back now, he only did it to keep me from following after him, didn't he...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Pretty much. It's just a normal sword he bought at the town weapon shop, anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, really!?」
How totally RPG!

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, it's supported me all this time.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Right up until I met you, Big Brother, it kept me going the whole way!」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Alzard will always be my treasure!」

name: Synn
message: 「...I'm sure Dad will come back before too long.」

name: Synn
message: 「You'll definitely see him again. I guarantee it.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Macaron
message: 「When we meet again, I'm gonna greet him properly!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll tell him, 'This time, I'm taking Big Brother for myself'」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? That's your greeting!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi, just kidding.」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't make my heart race like that...」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, if we're going to pay our respects, I have to go meet your parents too, Macaron.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Eh, that's... fine.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not fine.」

name: Macaron
message: 「It is fine. We don't get along, and they think I've gone delinquent anyway...」

name: Synn
message: 「Gone delinquent...」
Well, if a princess suddenly started sleeping outdoors, they might think it's strange, though....

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides, my home right now is here.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I get to be with you, Big Brother.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Master will come back too.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I have fun memories from after coming to the Human World.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because right now, this place is my home.」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihehe...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Welcome back, Big Brother.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm back. And also... welcome home, Macaron.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah, I'm home!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch, as usual, what the heck are you guys doing...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aah, I'm getting hungry--」

name: Synn
message: 「You're right. Shall we have lunch?」

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me is starving too!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Paqy-sama didn't do anything, so you don't need any food, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yep--」

name: Paqy
message: 「H-Hey, that's harsh!」
About Dad and Macaron... It feels like we got to share our memories, and that makes me happy.
Still, I really wish I could do something to help Macaron's parents....
